examples.vi: Đất nước rơi vào tình trạng hỗn loạn chính trị sau cuộc bầu cử.

senses.vi: sự xôn xao; sự hỗn loạn; cuộc nổi loạn

thesaurus.definition: a state of commotion and noise and confusion
violent agitation
the act of making a noisy disturbance

vi_block: Sự ồn ào, sự om sòm; tiếng ồn ào.
Sự xôn xao, sự náo động.
Sự bối rối, sự xáo động.

wiktionary.gloss: Confused, agitated noise as made by a crowd.

examples: the tumult of the elements
the tumult of the spirits or passions

A riot or uprising.

blocks.etymology: From unmentionable + -ly.

examples: They sat down and had one of their old chummy talks until an unmentionably late hour.
wiktionary.gloss: In an unmentionable way; indescribably, unutterably, unspeakably.

To be thrown up from below, causing a fault.

Rainy or damp weather.

blocks.etymology: From German Xylem, from Ancient Greek ξύλον (xúlon, “wood”).

thesaurus.definition: the woody part of plants: the supporting and water-conducting tissue, consisting primarily of tracheids and vessels

wiktionary.gloss: A vascular tissue in land plants primarily responsible for the distribution of water and minerals taken up by the roots; also the primary component of wood.
